source: Eaton, Power Xpert Meter 2000 Modbus TCP Register List (f/w 1.4, 2/3/2010)
notes: Modbus TCP, port 502, holding registers. This is the Ethernet register list of the PXM2250, PXM2260 and PXM2270; the RS-485 (RTU) map of the series is the separate IQ 250/260 style map (Eaton IB02601006E), see the IQ250 / IQ260 map in this library.
Register numbers are used as printed in the list (address base 0); the list does not say whether the number sent on the wire is one lower. The THD registers exist only on the PXM2260 and PXM2270.

The list gives no byte or word order; big-endian bytes with the high word first is assumed, as in Eaton's IQ 250/260 map for the same family. FLOAT registers are 32-bit; UINT registers of 2 registers are 32-bit; STRING registers give the number of registers as the length.

The DATE registers are 3 registers each; the list does not give the encoding, so each one is listed as three 16-bit words. Possible values that the list wraps over several lines (the I/O card limit ID registers, the accumulator divisors and the trigger levels) are not repeated here.

The 2 relay out / 2 digital in card repeats the identification registers (1032 to 2108) of the meter; they are kept under their own names, and the list does not state how the card is addressed (its own device or unit ID).
The entry 'A Restart is Pending' (register 3019, values true or false) has no register count or type in the list and is left out.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
